system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Records the transfer of livestock ownership from seller to buyer after successful payment. For your information, my order_id is None.

function.name: epashu_transfer_ownership
function.description: Records the transfer of livestock ownership from seller to buyer after successful payment. Transitions order_status to 'transferred'. Payment must be completed first. Requires session_token. Does NOT handle logistics. Fails if payment not done, order not confirmed, or ownership records conflict.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all transactional tools.
